# go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 reference cases

`cases.txt` (generated by `yamlref/gen.py 1 300`) and `expected.txt` (the output of
`yamlref/main.go`, built with go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.4 and Go 1.25.0) are the test data of
`../yaml_test.c`. Regenerate:

```bash
cd yamlref && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.0 GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go build -o /tmp/yamlref . && cd ..
python3 yamlref/gen.py 1 300 > cases.txt && /tmp/yamlref < cases.txt > expected.txt
```

The same programs compare larger random corpora: `python3 yamlref/gen.py <seed> <n>`, run through
`/tmp/yamlref` and `yaml_test --filter` (in the toolchain image), then diff.
